picks.file: Emmerik Høegh-Guldberg, Udsigt over Aarhus fra en i nærheden liggende Klint, 1836, ARoS Aarhus Kunstmuseum.tif
picks.what: View of the town across the bay from a nearby cliff, painting (ARoS Aarhus Art Museum)
picks.why: dated; the cathedral and the small town on the bay; better resolution than Holm’s similar view of about 1847

picks.file: Peter Holm - Sommerlandskab med udsigt over Aarhus Bugt set fra Moesgård - 1861.png
picks.what: The town and the bay seen from the south, painting
picks.why: clearest general view: cathedral tower, rooftops and harbor with ships

picks.file: Domkirke cathedral spire and view of Aarhus seen from Salling rooftop 03.jpg
picks.what: The cathedral, the rooftops and the harbor from the Salling rooftop, photograph
picks.why: color; cathedral spire with Aarhus Ø and the bay; rooftop planter mostly trimmed

gaps: P0–P2: no candidates; P5: only a 1914 sea view from the harbor with no town
notes: #2 (Holm, 1816–75) too loosely dated; #3 (Holm, about 1847) is a fine alternative for P3. P4 others (#5, #6, #9, #10) show the town only as a faint strip; #8 is Marselisborg Palace. #4 is a cathedral interior. #12/#14 (2012 panorama) is the fallback for P6.
